feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 May 2026 4:30pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 06 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in the east of the area for a time.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure over Scotland and the North Sea with a developing area of low pressure to the south of Iceland.


##Wind##

Southeast 3 or 4, backing southerly 3 or 4 later this evening, but southeast 5 occasionally 6 in the east of the area for a time overnight, increasing south 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon, but becoming variable 3 or less in the east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, isolated showers tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or south-southwest 4 or 5, becoming variable 3 or less on Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
